name: Cuddagh South
questions: BuyerIQ places this Eircode inside the OPW 1-in-100 river flood extent: has the house, garage, garden or access road ever flooded, and is buildings insurance with flood cover in place now?
Can you send a floor plan or room list with dimensions? Which bedroom is the ensuite, are all three bedrooms on the ground floor, and how is the floored attic reached (stairs or a hatch)?
Is water from the mains, a group scheme or a private well, and is drainage a septic tank or treatment unit? Please share its age and any inspection or certificate.
What is the second half of the 'dual heating system' alongside the oil boiler, and what did heating cost last year?
Can you send a site map of the 1.68 acres: how far does the house sit from the road, and is the boundary fenced and gated for dogs?

ai.why: A 2006 single-storey house of 147 m² on 1.68 acres at €450k, BER C1, 17 km from Portlaoise's ED and Dublin trains. Against it: BuyerIQ puts the Eircode in the 1-in-100 river flood extent, it is 6 km from the nearest village, and the paediatric ED's future and the services are unconfirmed.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; not stated, but it is a lived-in 2006 house with an alarm.

water.detail: Unknown; not stated on Daft or MyHome (rural townland: mains, group scheme or well).

sewer.detail: Unknown; not stated, but a rural one-off house is almost certainly on a septic tank or treatment unit.

internet.detail: Fibre likely but not confirmed: MyHome ticks 'Broadband' with no detail, and NBI's Mountrath deployment area (about 2,567 premises ready to connect by Aug 2024) covers the townlands around Mountrath, Abbeyleix and Borris-in-Ossory. BuyerIQ's broadband line is behind its paywall; confirm on nbi.ie/map by Eircode.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Listed by MyHome as a bungalow with a floored attic for storage, so all three bedrooms, including the ensuite bedroom, should be at ground level; there is no floor plan or room list to confirm which room is which.

bedsNote: Single storey; one bedroom ensuite; floored attic used for storage
heating: Oil-fired central heating; listed as a 'dual heating system' without naming the second source
tagline: A 2006 three-bed, three-bath bungalow of 147 m² on 1.68 acres in the south Laois countryside, about 6 km north-west of Ballacolla and 8 km from Mountrath.

pros.detail: 147.21 m² on one level with three bedrooms (one ensuite) and three bathrooms: room for the parents to sleep downstairs with their own bathroom.

pros.text: 1.68 acres and a large detached garage
pros.detail: About 0.68 ha, well over the 1-acre target for the dogs, plus a big garage for workshop or storage.
163.57 kWh/m²/yr (C1 is 150–175), so no deep retrofit needed; listed as turnkey, with a floored attic for storage.

pros.text: Portlaoise ED and trains about 17 km
pros.detail: Midland Regional Hospital Portlaoise (24-hour ED with a paediatric extension opened May 2026) and Portlaoise station are about 17 km straight-line; Ballybrophy station is about 8 km.
Mountrath Community School (mixed, ~130 Leaving Certs, 83% to third level in the 2018 tables) is about 8 km; Heywood CS in Ballinakill is the alternative.
Abbeyleix (~10 km) has Bramley (Laois best restaurant 2026), McEvoy's and Morrissey's pub, plus a large SuperValu and two GP practices.

cons.text: In the OPW 1-in-100 river flood extent
cons.detail: BuyerIQ puts this Eircode inside the national 1% AEP fluvial flood extent and flags one critical finding; check flood history and insurance before bidding.
Ballacolla is about 6 km and Mountrath about 8 km straight-line: every errand, GP visit and school run is a drive.

cons.text: Portlaoise's paediatric ED has an uncertain future
cons.detail: The paediatric extension opened in May 2026, but a 2026 HSE reconfiguration plan proposes Model 2 status with children's emergency care moving to Tullamore (~38 km).

cons.text: Water, septic and heating not stated
cons.detail: Neither listing names the water supply or drainage, and the 'dual heating system' names only the oil boiler.

cons.text: No floor plan or room list
cons.detail: Neither Daft nor MyHome has a plan or room sizes, so the layout, the ensuite bedroom and the attic access are unconfirmed.
Shanahoe NS (64 pupils) is about 4 km and Ballacolla's St Pius X NS (44 pupils) about 6 km; no inspection reports retrieved.

cons.text: Setting, road and fencing not checked
cons.detail: No aerial or satellite check (no browser); the listing says 'peaceful countryside setting' but not how close the house sits to the road or whether the site is fenced for dogs.

trips.label: The 3 a.m. trip
trips.title: Midland Regional Hospital Portlaoise
trips.note: 24-hour adult and paediatric ED (paediatric extension opened May 2026), about 17 km straight-line; downgrade proposals recur, with Tullamore (~38 km) named for children's emergencies. St Luke's Kilkenny is the other all-ages ED.

trips.label: Errands in town
trips.title: Mountrath
trips.note: Mountrath (~8 km): Centra, primary care centre, pharmacy. Abbeyleix (~10 km) is the bigger heritage town with SuperValu and two GP practices.

trips.label: Into the city
trips.title: Kilkenny
trips.note: Kilkenny is about 35 km straight-line; Portlaoise (~17 km) is the nearer big town for shops and services.

trips.label: Day in Dublin
trips.title: Dublin city centre
trips.note: City centre by car via the M7. The train from Portlaoise is the other way in.

trips.label: Train to Dublin
trips.title: Portlaoise
trips.note: Portlaoise has Cork, Limerick and Galway/Westport intercity trains plus the Portlaoise commuter service to Heuston (weekday count not verified). Ballybrophy (~8 km) has only a handful of Heuston trains a day.
